name: BACH_0084
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (100%)** · Confident · Careful review
Flagged tier-2 priority for suspected invasion [F1]; ER, PR, HER2, and Ki-67 stains are drafted.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Invasive 100%, InSitu 0%, Benign 0%, Normal 0% | Single dominant class (dataset ECE 5%) |
| Conformal set | Invasive (alpha 10%) | Separates Invasive at 90% dataset coverage |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% / 64th percentile (12/12 regions) [F6] | Typical input; passed quality control |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive (87%–89% similarity) [F5] | All nearest reference cases match |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 6, 8, 11) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical score (+0.66 contribution) pushing toward invasion [F2] · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 6, 8, 9) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical score (+0.64 contribution) supporting invasive read [F3] · Validated
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 11) · context · Below-typical score (+0.50 contribution); descriptive only [F4] · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 10) · ↑ invasive · Low score pushes toward invasion (+0.43); 0/20 spot check · Unreliable
- **Variation in nuclear size** (regions 4, 5, 6) · context · 90th percentile size variation [F8]; 10th percentile mean area [F7] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Classifier-faithful; removing top-3 risk regions drops invasive probability above random (+0.011; 95% CI +0.002 to +0.020).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion CI -0.009 to +0.006 includes 0); leans on unreliable normal lobules, necrosis, and mitoses scores.

## Could be wrong if
- Atypical cells remain duct-confined, matching contrasting InSitu case BACH_0155 (84% similarity; differs in duct confinement and unreliable normal lobules).
- High immune cell proximity [F9] or dense cellularity (1284 neoplastic nuclei/mm²) in regions 4–6 mimics stromal invasion.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 4, 5, 6, 7**: Highest risk (99%–100%) and nuclear variation; confirm stromal invasion before approving ER/PR/HER2/Ki-67 orders.
2. **Regions 6, 8, 9, 11**: Peak infiltration and pleomorphism scores; confirm invasive nests versus inflammatory mimicry.
3. **Regions 3, 10**: Lowest risk (82%, 49%) with duct-confined and tubule scores; check for in situ component.
